name: openoutreach_prompts
description: Reusable prompt pack derived from the openoutreach capability.

prompts.name: define_product_and_target
prompts.template: Describe your product: {product_description}. Define your target market: {target_market_profile}.
prompts.use_case: Businesses seeking to automate LinkedIn lead generation campaigns.

prompts.name: generate_leads
prompts.template: Find leads on LinkedIn for a product with description: {product_description} targeting: {target_market_profile}.
prompts.use_case: Sales teams requiring AI support to identify potential clients within specific markets.

prompts.name: summarize_campaign
prompts.template: Provide a summary report for the LinkedIn outreach campaign including leads found and actions taken.
prompts.use_case: Marketing professionals aiming to streamline and scale LinkedIn outreach.
